clock.calendarNote: The year 9001 is an artificial simulation calendar marker. The novels give no calendar dates and no clock times; every date and HH:MM shown is a reconstructed placement on a 10-minute grid, not canon.

coordinateSystem.description: x in [0,1] left->right, y in [0,1] top->bottom, measured against public/maps/base-atlas.png at its native 2641 x 2035 pixels. These are simulation coordinates for a fictional world. They are NOT Earth latitude/longitude and must never be presented as such.
coordinateSystem.disclaimer: Every RECONSTRUCTED position is a rendering convenience. It is surfaced in the interface as RECONSTRUCTED and must not be read as canon.
